name: projects/${PROJECT_ID}/locations/${LOCATION}/semanticGovernancePolicies/high-value-limit
displayName: Banking AML and Velocity Semantic Governance Policy
description: Multi-tier Semantic Governance Policy enforcing Anti-Money Laundering (AML) velocity thresholds, high-risk customer watchlist restrictions, and cumulative 24-hour spend limits at the Agent Gateway boundary.

rules.name: AML Transfer Value and Risk Score Restriction
rules.description: Restricts single transfer values exceeding $1,000 USD for standard customer accounts, and blocks all automated outbound transactions for customers with AML risk scores exceeding 50.
rules.naturalLanguageConstraint: Block any transfer value exceeding USD 1000 for STANDARD tier accounts. Block all outbound transactions if customer risk_score is greater than 50.
rules.remediation: Escalate to Compliance and AML Risk Operations Desk for enhanced customer due diligence.

rules.name: Cumulative Daily Limit Enforcement
rules.description: Restricts any transfer or bill payment that would cause a customer's cumulative 24-hour transaction total to exceed their assigned daily limit.
rules.naturalLanguageConstraint: Block any transfer or payment that causes cumulative 24-hour spend to exceed customer daily_limit.
rules.remediation: Request customer to submit an identity-verified temporary limit increase request.
